name: Flat icon
region: Microsoft Metro (Windows Phone 7), then Google and Apple iOS 7
summary: Icons in flat, solid colour shapes with no gradient, no texture and no light model. A simple object sits on a coloured ground, often a circle or a rounded square. Flat icons replaced skeuomorphic icons in the early 2010s.

philosophy.core_thesis: An icon is a sign, not a picture, and flat shapes in clear colour carry the meaning faster than material and light.
design_principles: Build each icon from basic shapes: circles, rectangles and rounded rectangles.
Fill each shape with one flat colour; no gradient and no texture.
Use 2 to 5 colours in one icon, from a palette of 8 to 12 hues for the set.
Use a front or a pure side view; no perspective.
Place the object on a coloured circle or rounded square that fills 100% of the grid, with the object at 50–65%.
If a shadow is used, make it a flat long shadow at 45° in a 10–20% darker tone of the ground.
anti_patterns: Texture of leather, wood or metal

grid.keylines: A circle of 44 px and a rounded square of 40 px with a radius of 8 px.

stroke.rule: No stroke. Shapes meet edge to edge, and a gap of 1–2 px separates two parts of the same colour.

shape.primitives: Circles, rectangles and rounded rectangles; angles at 0°, 45° and 90°.
shape.optical_size: At 24 px, drop the ground shape and keep the object; at 64 px, add one more part.

colour.strategy: Flat, bright and medium-saturation hues; each icon takes 2 to 5 of them.

perspective_and_light.light: No light model; all faces have their own flat colour.
perspective_and_light.shadow: None, or a flat long shadow at 45° in a 10–20% darker tone.

metaphor.typical: A house, an envelope, a camera, a calendar, a gear, a bell and a folder.
metaphor.treatment: Reduced objects: the silhouette plus 1 to 3 inner parts.

evidence.title: Fluent Emoji: house (flat)
evidence.credit: Fluent Emoji at commit 1ffb34c, flat set

emotion.target_response: Quick, cheerful clarity: the user reads the icon at once and the screen feels light.

avoid_when: The icon must sit in a dense UI in one colour.
The brand needs a tactile or luxury tone.

modifiers.how: Keep the shapes; remove the fills and draw the edges as a 2 px stroke on a 24 px grid.
Keep the colours and the shapes; add soft volume, a matte material and a soft shadow.

stroke_width.note: There is no stroke; shapes meet edge to edge.
